posts.title: DEUTERONOMY 32:33 (Morning Stars: Dragons and a class)
posts.description: If there is any such thing as true evil in the world, it was the Dragons . Georg Janny They were the enemy to all people, fighting a war that ended in prehistory. They ate everything and burnt what they could not eat, living blast furnaces knowing only cruelty and scorched earth. They haunted every age, dwindling down one by one by the hands of kings and prophets- the Dragons were made to persist,

posts.title: 1 CORINTHIANS 13:12 (Mask Relay 40)
posts.description: Previous: Purplecthulhu Next: Zmia Garinia It is a strange sort of mask. The outside is a featureless dome of unlacquered hardwood, stained dark by years of handling. The inside, however, is contoured to a human face and lined with mirror-polished silver- viewed from the right angle, its concave face would appear as the uncanny un-face of the viewer.
